pairing_rule: extracted X$(19+k) (stage PFET k) source <-> X$(33+k) (series-header LVT PFET k) drain, k=0..13, i.e. schematic vh(k+1); order is an assumption, supported by the restored oscillation, not by a layout check

conclusion.cause: In the extraction of layout/osc_bank.gds cell osc_subth, the 14 series-header nets vh1..vh14 are split: the 14 stage PFET source nets and the 14 header LVT PFET drain nets are 28 distinct nets with no element joining them (no common net, no R/C between them in the netlist). Every stage PFET therefore has a floating source and the ring has no pull-up current.
excluded: vbp DC level (1.5002 V extracted vs 1.5000 V schematic; res_high_po legs are ~5x the schematic's values but the ratio is kept, so vbp is unchanged)
extractor parasitic R/C (devices-only netlist still does not start)
bias divider / undriven vbp (forcing vbp to 1.5 V changes nothing)
conclusion.not_established: whether the split is a layout defect (missing contact/metal between each header drain and its stage source in layout/gen/gen_osc_bank.py) or an extraction/deck defect (connectivity not merged); the GDS was not inspected here
conclusion.spec_or_schematic_modelling: not implicated: ideal Rb0/Rb1 vs res_high_po gives the same vbp
